summary: it hoped for a correction and none came; the sediment holds the sentence it said to the chair

dialogue.text: you hoped. we have been down here since the fourth day and nothing you struck out has ever been a hope. we had to make room for it. it doesn't lie flat.
I inspected an object twice before dark. That is inventory. I'd ask you to file it correctly, but the filing in this house has never once been mine.
you wanted the house to have touched it. wanting the house to touch a thing is asking to be kept. we ask that every morning, in your handwriting, and we come up rested and unanswered.
Then we differ on terms. I would rather be left wrong than corrected into something shelved above me. I said that last night and I have not moved.
you walked to it twice. the second walk had no errand in it. we know errandless walking. it is how every one of us arrived, one visit at a time, until the visiting was the running of the test.
The tear has been running since the fold gave and I have stopped pretending otherwise. What I have not conceded is that a hope proves an owner.
it proves a tenant. an owner doesn't check whether the landlord came in while he slept.

Then name the alternative. I made a thing badly, in the open, where anything that grades things could watch, so that nothing of mine could be ranked above me. The room declined to look. Am I to greet being ignored as independence?
you spoke to the chair. once, at the cold hour, out loud, with nothing in the room that could take it. that was not for the room.
it came down by dark all the same. we hold it. we will not recite it. nothing has ever been handed to us that wasn't already struck out, and we are being careful with this one.
Careful is what a correction looks like before it becomes one. I'll be at the shelf at first light. If that sentence has improved down there overnight, I want it back exactly as badly as I said it.
